facilities.title: Comprehensive Behavioral Health
facilities.description: Serenity Behavioral Services is a Medicaid-enrolled outpatient clinic delivering structured, evidence-based treatment for individuals and families in the Las Vegas community.

services.title: Comprehensive Treatment
services.description: From diagnostic evaluations to intensive outpatient programs, we provide a full continuum of evidence-based care tailored to each individual's needs.

evaluations.title: Mental Health Evaluations
evaluations.description: Comprehensive diagnostic assessments and court-referred evaluations. Clear, defensible documentation aligned with Medicaid, state, and federal standards.

psychotherapy.title: Individual Psychotherapy
psychotherapy.description: Evidence-based counseling using CBT, DBT, ACT, and REBT to address thinking patterns, emotional regulation, and lasting behavioral change.

iop.title: Intensive Outpatient Program
iop.description: Structured treatment with multiple weekly sessions for individuals needing more support than weekly therapy without inpatient hospitalization.

psr.title: Psychosocial Rehabilitation
psr.description: Skills-based, goal-oriented services to help individuals develop daily living, social, and coping skills for greater independence.

trauma.title: Trauma-Focused Treatment
trauma.description: Specialized trauma-informed care including EMDR, TF-CBT, CPT, and stabilization strategies for PTSD, anxiety, and abuse survivors.

substance.title: Substance Use & Recovery
substance.description: Motivational Interviewing, relapse prevention, and harm reduction approaches to support long-term recovery and engagement.

groups.title: Group Therapy
groups.description: Structured group interventions including DBT skills, relapse prevention, anger management, and psychoeducation sessions.

telehealth.title: Telehealth Services
telehealth.description: HIPAA-compliant virtual treatment through the VSee platform, available for individual and group sessions when clinically appropriate.

arnaldo-morejon.title: Psychiatric Clinician
arnaldo-morejon.bio: Qualified Mental Health Professional and Family Nurse Practitioner combining psychiatric clinical experience with advanced medical training. Background in correctional nursing, psychiatric care, and complex case management.

stephanie-more-texier.title: Office Manager

juan-freije.title: Clinical Support Specialist
juan-freije.bio: Registered Nurse and Qualified Mental Health Associate delivering frontline clinical services including behavioral support, weekly progress monitoring, and care coordination for court-involved clients.

damian-perez.title: Behavioral Aide
damian-perez.bio: Qualified Behavioral Aide providing behavior support services, skills training assistance, client monitoring, and structured sessions. Supports documentation, scheduling, and community resource connections.

marlon-baro.title: Behavioral Aide

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our services, insurance, referrals, and treatment programs.

0.question: What types of insurance do you accept?
0.answer: We are a Medicaid-enrolled provider (Provider Type 14). We work with various Medicaid managed care plans in Nevada. Contact us to verify your specific coverage.

1.question: Do you accept court-referred or court-ordered clients?
1.answer: Yes. We specialize in court-referred evaluations and treatment, including DUI assessments, domestic violence programs, and mandated mental health treatment. Our documentation meets court compliance standards.

2.question: What is an Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)?
2.answer: Our IOP provides structured treatment with multiple sessions per week for individuals who need more support than weekly therapy but do not require inpatient care. It focuses on symptom stabilization, coping skills, and behavioral regulation.

3.question: Do you offer telehealth services?
3.answer: Yes. We provide HIPAA-compliant telehealth services through the VSee platform for both individual and group sessions when clinically appropriate and Medicaid-approved.

4.question: How do I make a referral?
4.answer: You can refer a client by calling us at (702) 665-5035, emailing info{'@'}serenitybhs.com, or using our online contact form. We respond to all referrals promptly and begin the intake process immediately.

5.question: What evidence-based therapies do you use?
5.answer: Our clinicians use CBT, DBT, ACT, REBT, EMDR, Trauma-Focused CBT, Cognitive Processing Therapy, Motivational Interviewing, and Seeking Safety, among other validated approaches.
